About Me

I am Faiz Azzahra Winanto Putra, a digital designer and developer focused on creating premium interactive web experiences that leave a lasting impression.

Bridging the gap between design and engineering, I specialize in UI/UX design, frontend development, and creating seamless user journeys. My goal is to build digital products that are not only visually stunning but also highly functional.
